usage: deskops add board [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                         [--title TITLE] [--summary SUMMARY]
                         [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]] [--scope SCOPE]
                         [--purpose PURPOSE] [--tasks TASKS [TASKS ...]]
                         [--pills PILLS [PILLS ...]]
                         [--rituals RITUALS [RITUALS ...]] [--notes NOTES]

Create a board artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the board payload from a YAML file.
  --title TITLE         Board title for one active routing surface.
  --summary SUMMARY     Short semantic summary for the primitive.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Semantic tags placed at the end, using namespaced forms such as 'system:sldb' or 'workspace:desk'.
  --scope SCOPE         What area or workspace this board routes.
  --purpose PURPOSE     Why this board exists and what it indexes.
  --tasks TASKS [TASKS ...]
                        Active task document references routed by this board.
  --pills PILLS [PILLS ...]
                        Active pill document references routed by this board.
  --rituals RITUALS [RITUALS ...]
                        Ritual document references relevant to this board.
  --notes NOTES         Short operational notes about the current routed set.

Example:
  deskops add board --root . --title "Example"
